User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account and their role (e.g. standard or admin).

id.description: The unique user ID matching their authenticated account.

email.description: The verified email address of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was first created.

Favorite.title: Favorite
Favorite.description: Indicates a bookmarked or favorited match for a specific user.

userId.description: ID of the user who favorited the match.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the bookmark was created.

History.title: History
History.description: Records predictions made by users for particular matches.

userId.description: ID of the user who recorded the prediction.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the history item was saved.

Analysis.title: Analysis
Analysis.description: Cached Gemini sports analytics data per match to optimize latency and costs.

analysisText.description: The detailed markdown content generated by Gemini.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the text was generated.

/users/{userId}.description: Collection storing user roles and details mapped by user ID.

/favorites/{favoriteId}.description: Collection storing favorite matches mapped by compound custom ID or random ID.

/history/{historyId}.description: Collection storing prediction histories mapped by compound or random ID.

/analyses/{matchId}.description: Collection storing cached match intelligence markdown text.
